posts.title: Query Rewriting
posts.description: A concept not unique to RAG, query rewriting is the act of adjusting the user’s input to enhance results. In a RAG application, this can mean providing additional context beyond the query itself. A common example: User: How many zip codes are there in Texas? AI: There are approximately 1,900–1,935 zip codes. User: And how about Colorado? Sending the last message from the user raw would result in n
